message: Color literal `#fff` has 3 hexadecimal digits; colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.
Color literal `#12345` has 5 hexadecimal digits; colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.
Color literal `#12345g` contains `g`, which is not a hexadecimal digit; colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.
Color literal `#` has no hexadecimal digits; colors are `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`.
